name: Quench
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sea of molten metal stretching to a horizon — a raymarched wavy surface that mirrors a hot forge sky, with emissive lava pooling in the troughs between cooling crests and sharp glints riding the swell. A flowing metal surface rather than an object.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Speed the molten waves travel; 0 freezes the surface.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: Wave height and chop; low is a near-flat mirror, high a rolling molten sea.

params.label: Heat
params.effect: Glow of the molten lava pooling in the troughs; 0 leaves cool mirror metal.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: Mirror finish — sharpness of the sun glints riding the crests.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera over the sea; 0 ignores the mouse.
